name: A Pretty Price For Pizza And Pasta
source:
Speak to the quirky, wacky rats of Toni Pepperoni's pizza and pasta shop to uncover the murder of Toni's best friend and business partner, Linguine Fettucine!

Everyrat has a secret, and with you on the case, none of them are safe!!!

[From [url=https://10eekahh.itch.io/a-pretty-price-for-pizza-and-pasta-renpy]Itch.io[/url]]
